---
title: Breader2
subtitle: "just get'em"
execute:
  echo: false
---

> _bsInput_ --> _validate/fetch_ --> _display_

- OK x=> x echo input
- next x=> osis

- super_bcv_parser does _the validation_ of an input string and 
- bsInputAndDebounce manages _the UI_, reacts with a _transform/validation_ method, triggers the _fetch_

```{mermaid}
graph LR
  bsInputAndDebounce --> super_bcv_parser
```


Attention! _uncaught (in promise) Error: A listener indicated an asynchronous response by returning true, but the message channel closed before a response was received_
Fix: is input is unchanged from previous dont trigger the fetch

::: {#inputDiv}
<!-- inputDiv is considered Void-->
:::

```{ojs}
import { bsInputAndFetch2 } from "./bsui_debounce.js"
import { SuperParser } from "./bsBcv2.js";

superBCV = new SuperParser(); // instance of singleton parser
//dummy = superBCV.parse("Gen1.1"); // warm JIT

viewof refInput2 = {
  const bsgroup = new bsInputAndFetch2({
    prefixHTML: "<i class='bi bi-book'></i>",
    placeholder:  "Here Bible Reference…",
    transform: superBCV.osis_array,     // <---- HERE
//    transform:  superBCV.parseOsis,     // <---- HERE
//    fetcher: superBCV.fetchPassage,
    fetcher: superBCV.fetch_json,
//    fetcher: superBCV.fetch,
    parsingInspector: superBCV.parsingInspector,
//    addLabel: "Add",
    resetLabel: "RAZ"
//    clipLabel: "CLIP"
  }).node();

  return bsgroup;
}

//refInput2.current   // "John.3.16"
html`<pre>${JSON.stringify(refInput2.current)}</pre>`   // "John.3.16"

//refInput.accum     // ["John.3.16", ...]
refInput2.content   // sanitized passage_html from your Worker

// OJS will wait for 'data' to resolve before running cells that depend on it.
```
